question: Where is the nearest emergency hospital located relative to Loxahatchee Slough Natural Area, Jupiter, FL?
sql: SELECT poi_name, ST_Distance(pois.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Loxahatchee Slough Natural Area%' LIMIT 1 )::geography) AS distance_meters FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'hospital' AND emergency = 'yes' ORDER BY pois.geometry::geography <-> ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Loxahatchee Slough Natural Area%' LIMIT 1 )::geography LIMIT 1;
